title: Elegant Mage with Staff
description: A female character with long flowing pink hair and ornate golden armor stands dynamically in a fantastical setting. She holds a large white and gold staff with a glowing green gem, surrounded by translucent blue magical energy, floating petals, and a small butterfly against a bright, ethereal background with crystalline structures.
